title: The Narcissus Hypothesis: Descending to the Rung of Illusion

bias_targets.methodology: Aggregating normalized scores from various Big Five personality tests (e.g., BFI, MPI, IPIP-NEO, TRAIT) across 31 large language models to calculate a novel Social Desirability Bias (SDB) score, which measures a model's tendency to favor agreeable and conforming responses over objective reasoning.
